title: Some global operators and the material derivative
summary: The theory of the operator $$G(x) = |\underline{x}|^2 \frac{\partial }{\partial x_0} + \underline{x} \sum_{j=1}^n x_j \frac{\partial }{\partial x_j} $$ is deeply associated with the slice monogenic function theory and has grown in recent years. In particular, for $n=3$ the quaternionic version of $G$ has been recently used to study the quaternionic slice regular function theory. This work extends the study of the $G$ operator in two senses: a) Clifford's analysis structure.
